findings.title: A web page can call tin's tools through adb forward
findings.claim: /mcp accepts any Origin, any Host and any Content-Type; over adb forward every connection is uid 2000, so the uid check passes for any local process, a browser included.

evidence.detail: POST /mcp parses the body as JSON without looking at headers
only content-length and connection headers are read

verification.method: lead read the code at d0c7daa independently of the finder
verification.result: confirmed: a text/plain cross-origin POST needs no preflight and reaches server.handle; DNS rebinding can read the reply

findings.trigger: adb forward tcp:7381 is up and the owner opens a hostile page
findings.fix: 403 on a foreign Origin or Host, 415 unless application/json

findings.title: A slow or endless request line holds a thread and memory
findings.claim: read_line has no length cap on both listeners; the unix socket has no read timeout.

verification.method: lead read the code at d0c7daa independently of the finder
verification.result: confirmed by reading; the TCP decision listener is reachable from the tailnet

findings.trigger: a client that never sends a newline, or never sends at all
findings.fix: cap line length and header count, idle read timeout
